SURVIVAL GUIDE

One more dawn.

Move with WASD or the arrow keys. On touch screens, drag anywhere on the arena to move. Your hero automatically fires at nearby enemies.

Each defeated enemy gives XP immediately. At every level-up, time stops and you choose one of three passive abilities. Abilities stack for stronger effects.

The horde grows over time. Fast enemies arrive after 25 seconds, brutes after 55 seconds, and an elite warden every minute. There is no final wave.

Use Esc / P to pause, 1–3 to choose an upgrade. Death ends the run. Your longest survival is saved on this device.
